supported_claim: Safe compatibility baseline for the current metric.
current_local_answer: Current fixed sleep is the conservative behavior and produces the settled local q50 band.
minimum_validation: No extra validation needed to keep it; only needed as the comparison boundary for replacements.
overclaim_failure_mode: Costly wait remains in CI, but it does not redefine the metric.

supported_claim: Best local fixed fallback, not a semantic readiness predicate.
current_local_answer: All exact q50s stay inside or below the 1000ms range; no run exceeds the 1000ms max; q50 sd is 0.62x baseline.
minimum_validation: CI, local macOS, and container lanes preserve q50 band, retained counts, preview/canvas success, resource boundary, and run-to-run q50 sd.
overclaim_failure_mode: Overclaiming this as a source readiness signal would hide that it is still a sleep.

supported_claim: Required semantic first check, but rejected as a complete timing replacement.
current_local_answer: Pure predicate resolves in about 0.15ms, moves 0 resources before timing, leaves about 25 resources inside measurement, and stays near fixed 0ms.
minimum_validation: Keep it before any guardrail; only reconsider as a complete replacement if another host shows it moving the same setup boundary.
overclaim_failure_mode: Using it alone would claim source readiness while preserving the unsettled 0ms timing boundary.

supported_claim: Best predicate-shaped guardrail candidate, explicitly not a pure product predicate.
current_local_answer: Median wait is about 301ms, quiet succeeds in all 30 retained samples, 19 resources move before timing, 7 remain inside, and median run q50 is 734.6ms.
minimum_validation: Validate with timeout/fallback telemetry, endpoint groups, active requests, resources before/during timing, q50 band, q50 sd, and preview-work preservation.
overclaim_failure_mode: Calling resource quiet the pattern predicate would hide that it mostly drains broader editor REST setup.

supported_claim: Still open research, not established by current evidence.
current_local_answer: No local source signal has been shown to predict the same resource drain and settled q50 boundary without broad resource quiet.
minimum_validation: Map moved endpoint groups to source-level resolvers/actions and show the signal predicts the boundary across CI/mac/container lanes.
overclaim_failure_mode: Inferring a source signal from broad resource quiet would erase the actual dependency boundary.

supported_claim: Invalid unless the benchmark intentionally changes what Loading Patterns means.
current_local_answer: Preview canvases and core/pattern replacement happen after the measured click and are part of the current metric.
minimum_validation: Only allowed under a new metric definition with a new name and side-by-side reporting.
overclaim_failure_mode: Pre-waiting this work would remove the workload the metric is supposed to charge.

supported_claim: Separate local candidate for the Post Editor path only.
current_local_answer: Focused local matrix favors 0ms over 1000ms, but Post Editor uses injected local patterns and a different measurement path.
minimum_validation: Validate q50, q50 sd, p90/mean, retained counts, first-iteration behavior, preview/canvas success, and source/resource telemetry in CI/mac/container lanes.
overclaim_failure_mode: Combining it with Site Editor readiness would overstate one generic loadPatterns result.

supported_claim: Reporting boundary that must be split by spec.
current_local_answer: Site Editor and Post Editor append to the same loadPatterns metric key even though their readiness contracts differ.
minimum_validation: Report Site Editor, Post Editor, and combined views separately before claiming total wait savings.
overclaim_failure_mode: One aggregate key can hide regressions or unsupported readiness claims in either spec.
